readout_other: Phasic skin conductance responses; retrospective threat probability, valence and arousal ratings
direction_notes: Amygdala-TUS slowed early threat acquisition, accelerated early extinction and raised retrospective threat-probability overestimation versus sham; hippocampus-TUS did not differ from sham.
safety_notes: Estimated exposure said to adhere to ITRUSST recommendations (safety metrics in table S1); adverse events not described in the text.

device.model: NeuroFUS Pro (TPO-203-035 / TPO-105-010 with CTX-250-001 / CTX-250-026)

timing.protocol_description: Pulses of 90-ms duration, ramped with a Tukey shape on pressure over 30 ms on/off, repeated at 5 Hz for a total pulse train of 1000 ms, delivered bilaterally and interleaved between the two transducers; TUS began 200 ms before CS onset on each active trial during the 120-trial acquisition phase only.
